name: The Windshapers
statusNote: New in Forever.  From Wowhead’s Forever database.

narrative.details:
<Illaya smiles warmly at you.>

I am glad you returned to speak with me, child of the winds. I knew it the first moment you walked into my presence, that you were strong in the skysight. Do you find this surprising? Even those who have not trained as a Shaman may possess the gift.

Come, let us speak about the mandate of the Windshapers, the nature of our struggles on Zephras, and the plight of our people.
narrative.objectives: Listen to what Illaya Amberwind has to say.
narrative.offerRewardText: I think you now understand how important the mission of the Windshapers is. Every soul who commands the skysight is of vital importance if we hope to establish dialogue with the spirits of the winds once again.Between threats from within such as the Al'Aketh, and the uncertainty of our safety here in Skywall, it is our responsibility as Windshapers to use our gifts to save our home and ensure that the Shen'dorei can survive these trying times.
narrative.requestItemsText: The world is changing and the path forward will be difficult. We have but one chance to save ourselves.
